The files give the SAMPL9 WP6 host (a carboxylated pillar[6]arene; host file shown with 12 carboxylates) and four candidate guests as 3D structures (XYZ, angstrom). Binding to WP6 was measured by isothermal titration calorimetry in 1× PBS at pH 7.40 and 298.15 K; all complexes are 1:1. You start from guest G7 (cyclohexylammonium), whose measured binding free energy to WP6 under these conditions is -6.97 kcal/mol, and want a replacement guest that binds WP6 at least 2.0 kcal/mol more strongly (measured ΔG ≤ -8.97 kcal/mol). Exactly one of the four candidates achieves this in the measured data. Which one?

选项：
A. G1: cyclododecylammonium (WP6-G1.xyz)
B. G2: 4-(1,1-dimethylpiperidin-1-ium-4-yl)-1,1-dimethyl-piperidin-1-ium (WP6-G2.xyz)
C. G6: cyclooctylammonium (WP6-G6.xyz)
D. G3: norbornan-2-ylammonium (WP6-G3.xyz)

附件：WP6.xyz、WP6-G2.xyz、WP6-G6.xyz、WP6-G3.xyz、WP6-G1.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：主体与客体为 SAMPL9 提供的 3D 结构；答案依据实测 ITC 结合自由能（1× PBS，pH 7.40，298.15 K，1:1），证据只在审核侧。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
